decision: remove state-cache and fused Conv+GDN candidates because exact register residency spills and exact launch fusion regresses model-scale decode

state_cache_candidates.design: retain original FP32 recurrent-state scalars across the delta dependency so the update does not reread them
state_cache_candidates.shape: rows=8, 16 K heads, 32 V heads, 128x128 state, five cycling 16 MiB states

full_128_scalar_cache.decision: reject because private-array spills turn the removed state reread into slower scratch traffic

partial_array_cache.decision: reject because the compiler retains spill-backed private arrays even at reduced cache widths

manual_scalar8_cache.decision: reject because the only spill-free point changes exact arithmetic and its theoretical model effect is below the admission threshold

fused_conv_gdn_candidate.design: one 256-thread block fuses indexed depthwise Conv with paired-value-head GDN; Q and K Conv channels are split across exact 128-thread subgroups and value channels remain disjoint
fused_conv_gdn_candidate.arithmetic_contract: Conv shift/FMA/SiLU and each GDN normalization, recurrent update, RMSNorm, and gate retain production order

primitive_microbench.shape: rows=8, qkv_width=8192, conv_kernel=4, 16 K heads, 32 V heads, 128x128 state
primitive_microbench.protocol: five cycling 1 MiB Conv plus 16 MiB GDN states, 40 warmups, 400 iterations

direct_screen.workload: physical-C8 p512/d128 state-bound graph, one warmup and one measured run

fused_conv_gdn_candidate.decision: reject before server because model-scale decode clearly regresses despite an exact isolated leaf win

limitations: The state layout is already coalesced across value dimensions; exact whole-state residency is compiler-spill limited on gfx1151.
The fused primitive gain cannot be retained because the actual captured model graph regresses with identical trajectories.
No server cycle was run for the direct-regressive fused candidate.
